goal: Create a client from environment variables, set a session value with a one-hour expiry, read it back typed, and delete it.
Implement a page-view counter that increments a key per page and returns the top 10 pages by views using a sorted set.
Store a user profile as a hash with several fields, update one field, read the whole hash back typed, and check whether a field exists.
Read three keys and increment a counter in a single round trip, and separately run two commands atomically.
Push items onto a capped recent-activity list keeping only the latest 50, and track unique visitors per day with a set and count them.
Store a nested JSON document, update one nested field in place, and read a single path from it.
Iterate over all keys matching a prefix without blocking the server, and delete them in batches.
Write a cache-aside helper that returns a cached value or computes and stores it with an expiry, and run a small server-side script that sets a key only if its current value matches.
